market_positioning_notes.source_basis: 2026 India AI/ML and Data Analyst hiring research (multiple industry sources, synthesized)
key_findings: Python appears in nearly all AI-adjacent job descriptions across role types — treated as non-negotiable.
Generative AI, RAG, and prompting skills are increasingly named explicitly even in Data Analyst postings, not just AI Engineer roles.
'Data Analyst with AI skills' is one of the most accessible, fastest-growing fresher entry points into the broader AI/ML career track.
Firms are prioritizing the ability to move data and models into production (data engineering, MLOps awareness), not just analyze in isolation.
A genuine, demonstrable project portfolio is repeatedly cited as the differentiator between freshers who get hired and those who don't.

projects.name: InsightSQL — Natural-Language-to-SQL Analyst Assistant
projects.problem: Non-technical business owners can't write SQL, so insights sit locked in databases until someone manually queries them.
projects.solution: An assistant that takes a plain-English business question, has an LLM generate the SQL against an explicit schema, executes it read-only against a real SQLite database, and returns both the result table and a plain-language insight summary.
projects.context_note: Schema modeled on a local sales-and-service business (AC sales, installation, AMC contracts) — the same domain as the AM Enterprises freelance project.
projects.safety_design: Model output is restricted to SELECT statements; execution layer hard-rejects any non-SELECT SQL before touching the database.
projects.status: Working CLI demo — code delivered alongside this portfolio.
roadmap: Auto-selected charting based on result shape
Point at real AM Enterprises order data once integrated

projects.name: Friday — Adaptive Offline AI Assistant Framework
projects.problem: Cloud-dependent LLMs are unusable in privacy-sensitive or low-connectivity environments; running full-size models on resource-constrained devices is impractical.
projects.solution: An adaptive multi-tier framework that dynamically selects among distilled models based on task complexity and device constraints, enabling low-latency, privacy-preserving offline AI inference without cloud dependency.
projects.status: Published research; prototype offline chatbot built and demonstrated.

projects.name: AI Resume Analyzer
projects.problem: Recruiters and applicants both need fast, structured extraction from unstructured resume text.
projects.solution: A full-stack web app using the Anthropic API to parse and analyze resumes; built specifically to pair full-stack JavaScript ability with the AI/ML skillset.

projects.name: E-Commerce Sales Performance Dashboard

projects.solution: EDA to surface sales and behavior patterns, RFM segmentation to classify customers for targeted marketing, and an interactive Power BI dashboard for stakeholder decision-making.
